findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous function usage in h11
 * @description Looking for usage of dangerous functions like eval, exec, pickle, etc.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/dangerous-function-usage
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially dangerous function call that could lead to code injection or arbitrary command execution."
findings.hypothesis: h11 may use dangerous functions like eval, exec, pickle, or subprocess calls which could lead to code injection

message.text: Potentially dangerous function call that could lead to code injection or arbitrary command execution.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dynamic code execution in h11 package
 * @description Look for eval, exec, or other dynamic code execution in h11
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-execution-h11
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("compile").getACall()
select call, "Dynamic code execution or command execution found"
findings.hypothesis: Dynamic code execution vulnerabilities (eval, exec, os.system) in h11 library

message.text: Dynamic code execution or command execution found
